MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 13

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

7. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

8. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 12
   C. 10
   D. 9

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 5

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 16

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²
3. c² = 9 + 16
4. c² = 25
5. c = 5
Final Answer: 5 cm
